# Assets · Logos

2 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for logo.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Logos

The SuDu AI logo, supplied as single-colour artwork. **Ink: black** — each file is authored with `fill="currentColor"`, which renders black through `<img>`. For any other colourway inline the `<svg>` markup or use the `Logo` / `LogoIcon` components, which take a `color`.

| File | Use | Ratio |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `logo.svg` | Primary logo — alien head + wordmark lockup. The default way the brand signs a surface. | 205.68 : 50.79 |
| `logo-icon.svg` | Logo icon — the head alone, for favicons, avatars, collapsed rails, watermarks. | 76.05 : 50.79 |

- Colourways: `on-surface` in neutral chrome, `primary-container` where the logo is the accent, `brand-obsidian` knocked out of a neon field.
- Clear space on every side equals the height of the head. Minimum lockup height 18px; below that use the icon.
- The lettering reads "SuDu Ai" — it is artwork. Running text always writes "SuDu AI". Never rebuild the lockup in live Figtree.
- These files carry C2PA provenance metadata, so they fail as a CSS `mask-image` source (renders a solid block). Use `<img>` or inline the markup.
